title: Hosted API Model Release Playbook — Q2 cadence, gating criteria, and rollback runbook
creator: Priya Nambiar
description: Create a repeatable, cross-functional playbook to manage quarterly model releases for the Hosted API catalog. The playbook covers cadence (canary -> staged -> GA), concrete gating criteria (latency, cost delta, quality regressions by prompt-suite), rollback signals and runbook, and owner responsibilities across PM, Eng, SRE, and Trust. The deliverable will be a living Confluence doc, a checklist used by Release Managers, and a set of short runbooks hooked into the Console incident flow.
objectives: Standardize quarterly model release cadence so releases can be executed within a 3-week window with <24h hotfix capability
Define measurable gating criteria that combine telemetry (p50/p95 latency, token cost), quality (prompt-suite pass rate), and safety (TBD metrics)
Provide clear rollback/runbook steps tied to Console alerts and incident playbooks
Reduce rollout-induced customer errors by 50% relative to last quarter through canary tooling and automated evaluation hooks
okrs_mapping: OKR-Platform-2026-Q2: Improve inference reliability (reduce model-induced errors)
OKR-Product-2026-Q2: Increase hosted-model adoption by surfacing stable, verified defaults
OKR-Cost-2026-Q2: Reduce per-token cost variance through pre-release quantization guidance

acceptance_criteria: Confluence playbook exists and is review-approved by PM, Eng, SRE, and Trust
A canary release executed using the playbook with telemetry captured in Console dashboards
Automated pre-release evals run for the model and results visible in the release checklist
Rollback runbook tested in tabletop and can be executed in under 45 minutes by on-call SRE
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Quality regressions missed by current prompt-suite. Mitigation: Expand suite by +30 prompts from high-traffic customers and run A/B comparisons
Risk: Console alert fatigue could cause missed rollback signals. Mitigation: Add a dedicated release severity level and routed notifications to release owners
Risk: Dependencies on Dedicated infra autoscaling (ENG-4720) may delay staged rollout. Mitigation: Gate staged phase on autoscale test signoff and provide fallback to lower-capacity model variant
